en.headline: 6 own commits plus 8 automated commits in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu
en.summary: **6** own commits were made in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 8 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The own work updated `.gitignore` rules for `.history` and daily report drafts, added explanatory comments to error handling in `generate-activity.mjs`, and corrected the `.history/scripts/daily` path format. It also refactored diagnosis probing so deduplication keys include headers and probes have a `catch` fallback, then optimized concurrent probing to reduce duplicate requests. In `openchamber/openchamber`, issue #5584, “[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”, was opened and remains open with 1 comment. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied that the cause was traced and the fix mainly requires wiring the existing `loadHistoryUntilMessage` behavior. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or state changes were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 有 6 次本人提交，另有 8 次自动提交
zh.summary: 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 完成 **6** 次本人提交，另有 8 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。本人提交更新了 `.gitignore` 中针对 `.history` 和日报草图的忽略规则，为 `generate-activity.mjs` 中的错误处理函数添加注释，并修正 `.history/scripts/daily` 的路径格式。诊断探测的重构使去重键包含 headers，并为 probe 增加 `catch` 兜底；随后又优化并发探测逻辑，减少重复请求。在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开 issue #5584“[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”，该 issue 仍为开放状态，共有 1 条评论。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复称已定位原因，修复主要是接入现有的 `loadHistoryUntilMessage` 行为。当天没有 pull request、review、发布或状态变更记录。
